text: ApoE4 astrocytes showed aberrant accumulation of endosomal protons, i.e. hyperacidified (lower) endosomal pH, relative to the implied ApoE3 comparison.
description: ApoE4 astrocytes; species, source (primary, targeted-replacement mouse or iPSC), pH assay and comparison group not specified. Abstract-only. Caveat: the system may not be human, non-aged astrocytes.

provenance.excerpt: Here, we show that aberrant accumulation of endosomal protons in ApoE4 astrocytes traps the LRP1 receptor in non-productive intracellular compartments, leading to loss of surface expression and Aβ clearance.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower endosomal pH / endosomal hyperacidification in astrocytes) -> (LRP1 trapped intracellularly, reduced surface LRP1 and Aβ clearance)

perturbed.variable: APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes (comparison implied, not stated explicitly in the abstract)
